736:t_1:246.en:
$$クラン$$
「I wonder if there are still $$宇宙怪獣$$ left after all...」

736:t_1:247.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Even if there are, their nest has been destroyed, so their numbers are limited.」

736:t_1:248.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Besides, $$サイデリアル$$ and all sorts of other organizations throughout the universe joined forces to defeat the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

736:t_1:249.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I doubt enough remain to wipe out the force that seeks to exist... all the life in the universe...」

736:t_1:250.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Then is there some $$バアル$$ we don't know about...!?」

736:t_1:251.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Then I'll just let them hear my song too.」

736:t_1:253.en:
$$ランカ$$
「But the power of song let us understand the $$バジュラ$$ too.」

736:t_1:254.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Song is emotion... the power of life itself... As long as we're alive, we'll keep singing.」

736:t_1:255.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah! I'll sing until my voice reaches everything in the universe!」

736:t_1:256.en:
$$レド$$
「$$バサラ$$... If we survive, please visit the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

736:t_1:257.en:
$$レド$$
「I want the people of the Alliance to hear your songs too.」

736:t_1:259.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$ガルガンティア船団$$ is where I belong.」

736:t_1:261.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「So you've decided to run a repair shop with me?」

736:t_1:262.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Oh, $$ピニオン$$... Weren't you going to become a great man who sails every sea with me?」

736:t_1:263.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You probably won't have time to be a pirate.」

736:t_1:264.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's right. If we survive this battle, the world will surely change a great deal.」

736:t_1:265.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Whatever the world becomes, I'll be with $$ティファ$$.」

736:t_1:267.en:
$$パーラ$$
「What are you going to do, $$ロラン$$?」

736:t_1:268.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I don't know yet... I'll take my time thinking about it if we get back to Earth.」

736:t_1:269.en:
$$ロラン$$
(But if I'm allowed, there is something I've already decided...)

736:t_1:271.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Exactly. Having grasped the truth and reached the threshold of $$シンカ$$, you face a new world: the infinite universe.」

736:t_1:272.en:
$$隼人$$
「I see. If people who cannot coexist venture into space, they will only spread conflict.」

736:t_1:273.en:
$$弁慶$$
「I'm sick of fighting. If we're going into space, I'd rather make friends with everyone we meet.」

736:t_1:274.en:
$$タケル$$
「With that attitude, I'm sure we can live out in the universe.」

736:t_1:275.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「The former territories of $$ギシン星$$ will want friendly relations with Earth, which defeated $$ズール$$.」

736:t_1:276.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「At least the planets of the Milky Way seem grateful for Earth's efforts in the $$宇宙怪獣$$ extermination operation, and respect us.」

736:t_1:278.en:
$$ナオト$$
「Of course. We even drove off $$サイデリアル$$.」

736:t_1:279.en:
$$ミカ$$
「But we shouldn't have that kind of attitude.」

736:t_1:280.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Earth wasn't the only planet to fight $$サイデリアル$$ and the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

736:t_1:281.en:
$$さやか$$
「It was the result of people from all kinds of planets working together.」

736:t_1:282.en:
$$ボス$$
「It wasn't just people. The $$バジュラ$$ and $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ helped too.」

736:t_1:283.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「So when we go into space, we'll be dealing with folks like them too.」

736:t_1:284.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「Human girls are out of your league, $$ボス$$, so why don't we look for your girlfriend among them?」

736:t_1:285.en:
$$ボス$$
「That's not a bad idea either.」

736:t_1:287.en:
$$渓$$
「What are you talking about? You'll need at least that much openness to survive in the coming age.」

736:t_1:288.en:
$$葵$$
「But if we're expanding our horizons, I'd like to visit parallel worlds as well as space.」

736:t_1:289.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Are you looking for a lover there too, $$葵$$?」

736:t_1:290.en:
$$葵$$
「That isn't it. I want to see my seniors again too.」

736:t_1:291.en:
$$くらら$$
「Not just them, but the people we were separated from by the $$新世時空震動$$ too.」

736:t_1:295.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... Talking about dreams before a battle... You're taking things awfully easy.」

736:t_1:297.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah... Dreams and hopes give us the strength to live. As long as we have them, we can move forward.」

736:t_1:298.en:
$$號$$
「The final battle with the $$御使い$$s, and stopping the universe's great collapse... We will either enter a new age or lose everything.」

736:t_1:299.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's why... we can't lose. I still don't know how we'll do it, but I know how I feel.」

736:t_1:300.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's enough, $$甲児$$. ...Let's show those $$御使い$$s...」

736:t_1:301.en:
$$竜馬$$
「how we... how humanity fights with our lives on the line.」

736:t_1:303.en:
$$チコ$$
「Hey, hey, $$ノリコ$$, $$カズミ$$, what will you do when the fighting ends?」

736:t_1:304.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「After the $$時獄戦役$$, I planned to travel through space with the $$フロンティア船団$$. But now, what should I do...?」

736:t_1:305.en:
$$カズミ$$
「They'll be settling the $$バジュラ$$ planet, so it won't really be a journey.」

736:t_1:306.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then why don't you come with us?」

736:t_1:307.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Are we going... to the $$新世界大陸$$?」

736:t_1:308.en:
$$シモン$$
「No. It's a journey into the vast universe.」

736:t_1:309.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Is $$大グレン団$$ setting out into space?」

736:t_1:310.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「According to $$ロージェノム$$, with the $$アンチスパイラル$$ defeated, all sorts of Spiral life-forms have started expanding into space again.」

736:t_1:311.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「They're the people who helped us fight the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

736:t_1:312.en:
$$ギミー$$
「We're going to visit them and form $$超グレン団$$, active throughout the universe!」

736:t_1:313.en:
$$ダリー$$
「...That's $$ギミー$$'s dream, anyway, but I'd like to meet people from unfamiliar planets too.」

736:t_1:314.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「It is the beginning of a new adventure across the universe.」

736:t_1:316.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes, Big Sis! Let's join them too!」

736:t_1:319.en:
$$ニア$$
「We don't mind, but is that what you want, $$ノノ$$?」

736:t_1:320.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Once Earth is peaceful, there probably won't be anywhere for $$ノノ$$ to belong...」

736:t_1:321.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Well, I guess there's no helping it... Then I'll have to come too.」

736:t_1:323.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It annoys me to hear you say you've got nowhere to belong.」

736:t_1:325.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Someone who's running away from Earth shouldn't join $$大グレン団$$ as it sets out with hope.」
